summary: Frontend-only verification of employee role redirect + ProtectedRoute guard. All 7 redirect/guard scenarios pass. Employee users (rajesh@zartecsolutions.com, employee@test.com) are correctly forced to /daily-tasks at every entry point (login, manual URL entry, root '/', /login when authenticated). Admin (admin@test.com) and data_entry (admin@zartecsolutions.com) regressions verified — both still land on /dashboard and can access /customers without redirect. Daily Tasks screen only shows the Daily Tasks sidebar item (no other widgets) for the employee — confirming UI scoping is correct.

observations: Console logs show repeated 403 errors from /api/locations for employee users (MobileLayout still polls locations regardless of role). Functional but noisy. Same noise was already noted in iteration_7. Suggest gating LocationContext fetches behind role!=='employee' to silence noise — non-blocking.
WebSocket /api/ws/locations also fails with employee users (closed before connection established). Backend RBAC properly rejects. Non-blocking, cosmetic console noise.
Employee Daily Tasks screen sidebar shows only the Daily Tasks item with Logout button — UI scoping verified correct.
action_items: OPTIONAL (non-blocking): Skip location polling and WS connection for role==='employee' in LocationContext/MobileLayout to remove 403 console noise. Backend already enforces RBAC; this is purely a UX/log-cleanliness improvement.
critical_code_review_comments: ProtectedRoute, PublicRoute, and RoleAwareDefault implementations in /app/frontend/src/App.js are clean and consistent — all three honour role==='employee' -> /daily-tasks.
Login.js correctly reads result.user.role from the new login() return shape and routes accordingly.
AuthContext.login() now returns {success, user} which is consistent with downstream consumers.
Minor: LocationContext appears to fire /api/locations and WS even for employee role; consider role-aware short-circuit to avoid 403 spam in console (cosmetic).
